sql: SELECT y.trip_date, y.trips, d.d_day_name, h.holiday_name, CASE WHEN h.holiday_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_holiday FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = y.trip_date WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-01' AND DATE '2024-11-30' AND d.d_dow = 4 ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 500
